articulation.alt: use: /j/ → /u/ → /z/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /j/: Front tongue high; glide into the next vowel.
/u/: High back tongue; round the lips.
/z/: A narrow gap near the ridge; add voice.
